pages.purpose: Phone setup v2 screen B: a thin host for SetupProgressView. The job runs natively under a foreground service, so leaving this screen never stops it; coming back re-reads it. A first setup hands off to screen C (Ready) when done; an update or added tools just close back to where they were opened. The Termux host (PhoneSetupTermuxScreen, lib/ui/screens/phone_setup/phone_setup_termux_screen.dart, slice P1.3/P1.5 (2026-09-27)) draws the old Termux wizard as the same SetupProgressView checklist: Get Termux and Connect Termux once are rows only the person can do, then Linux base, OpenCode and Start OpenCode follow the Termux manager; a failure is a failed row with Continue setup. A first setup ends on home-shell, an update or a switch closes back to This phone. The persisted Termux job variant (PhoneSetupTermuxJobScreen, P5.3) also hosts SetupProgressView and hands first setup completion to Ready; its Get Termux, permission and resume actions are listed here.

pages.title: OpenCode is ready
pages.purpose: Phone setup v2 screen C: the agent is running, so the only thing left is a place to work. One step: a celebration drawing (SetupReadyScene, played once), 'OpenCode is ready', one name field whose primary 'Create and open' makes the project and lands in its first conversation, and the quiet 'Open a folder instead', which opens the folder sheet only when tapped (never on its own, so there is one name field on screen). Takes the progress screen's place (pushReplacement) so Back never returns to a finished setup.

reachedFrom.note: automatic hand-off, not a tap: when firstSetup and the job reaches SetupState.done (phone_setup_progress_screen.dart:78-92)

reachedFrom.trigger: phone setup notification tap when the job is done, firstSetup and screen C was not shown yet for this job (openPhoneSetupFromNotification, phone_setup_routes.dart:108-115)

elements.label: Close
elements.effect: _leave(): pushNamedAndRemoveUntil('/', (_) => false); PopScope also routes Back here.

elements.label: Project name
elements.effect: Prefilled with 'my-app' and selected; onChanged clears the field error, onSubmitted triggers Create.

elements.label: Create and open
elements.effect: _create(): validates the name, creates the project folder (BuiltinProjectFolders), ensures the app is connected, selects it as the location, creates a session, then pushNamedAndRemoveUntil('/home') and pushNamed('/chat/<id>', ChatRouteArguments.firstRun()).

elements.label: Open a folder instead
elements.effect: _openExisting(): ensures the app is connected, then ProjectFolderActions.openFolder(context, connection) (the same folder sheet Work and the project picker use); on a chosen path, pushNamedAndRemoveUntil('/home').

pages.title: Add tools to this phone
pages.purpose: Termux's own tools on This phone: the AI Team onboarding block (while the server runs and a Termux profile is saved) and the Claude Code row.

elements.label: Claude Code on this phone
elements.effect: Closes the sheet and pushes LocalAgentScreen; once connected it goes to /home.

pages.title: Remove OpenCode from this phone?
pages.purpose: The remove-from-phone sheet (P0.7/P1.5): says what survives. The default removes OpenCode and its tools, keeps the projects and names the space that comes back (BuiltinLinux.projectStorage, said only when measured); Delete everything is the heavy path.

elements.label: Remove OpenCode, keep my projects
elements.effect: Disconnects from the in-app server, BuiltinLinux.uninstall() (keeps /root/projects), then deleteProfileAndLocalData for every in-app profile.

elements.label: Delete everything
elements.effect: The alternative: closes this question and asks the typed-name delete.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Closes the question; nothing changes.

pages.title: Delete OpenCode and every project?
pages.purpose: The heavy delete: OpenCode, its tools and every project, with the space that comes back; the confirm stays off until the app name (OpenCode) is typed.

elements.label: [type OpenCode]
elements.effect: typedName: BuiltinLinux.deletionConfirmationName; enables the confirm when it matches.

elements.label: Delete everything
elements.effect: BuiltinLinux.remove(alsoDeleteProjects: true, confirmationName: OpenCode), then forgets every in-app profile.

pages.title: This phone
pages.purpose: The in-app server's one row wherever servers are listed (Servers, the server switcher). Only the menu items this slice changed are recorded: Manage This phone opens the page, Remove opens the remove-from-phone sheet.

elements.label: Manage This phone
elements.effect: runPhoneServerAction(manage): openThisPhone(context, kind: inApp). In the switcher the sheet closes first and the shell runs it.

elements.label: Remove from this phone…
elements.effect: runPhoneServerAction(remove): the remove-from-phone sheet.

pages.title: Move from Termux
pages.purpose: Move a Termux user's projects (and, opt-in, private exports of settings, history, Git/shell settings and AI Team state) to the in-app Ubuntu server: review with sizes and what does not move, copy with real stages, stop/resume, verify, switch, then next steps (sign in again, where things went, remove the Termux server when ready). Backend docs/qa/codex-termux-migration-2026-09-28; UI slice-migration-ui (2026-09-28).
gates: Termux profile present; the in-app server is set up first through setup v2 when missing

pages.title: Clear this app's storage
presentedBy: Android Settings › Apps › Storage › Manage space (manageSpaceActivity)
pages.purpose: Android's Clear storage button opens this first: what clearing deletes (in-app server, projects with sizes, conversations, saved servers) and keeps, Export projects first, clear the cache only, or a confirmed Delete everything (slice-clear-storage-guard, 2026-09-28).
gates: Android only; opened by the system, not from inside the app

notPages.reason: pure function `setupUiMessage(l10n, message)` mapping raw setup/bridge messages to localized text; no widget, surface or interactive element

navigation only: openPhoneSetupStart/showPhoneSetupCustomize/openPhoneSetupProgress/openPhoneSetupReady and openPhoneSetupFromNotification wire the phone setup screens together and route a setup notification tap; no surface or widget of its own.

pure arithmetic over the SetupComponent registry (defaultSetupSelection, expandSetupSelection, setupTotals, size/duration text, includedToolNames); no widget, surface or interactive element. Used by phone-setup-start and phone-setup-customize-sheet.

PhoneSetupWelcomeEntry is the first-run welcome's own status line about a phone setup job that already exists (running / stopped part way / done but nothing saved); embedded in servers-welcome (lib/ui/screens/servers_screen.dart:710), not a surface of its own. Its action button opens phone-setup-progress or resumes/reopens the job.
layout only: PhoneSetupHero draws setup start and ready (the drawing at the top, then the state's slots); its actions are the host screens' and are recorded on their pages

Part file of this_phone_screen.dart (same library, same page): the log fold, reply speed, performance values and installed list split out for size; recorded on the This phone page, not a surface of its own.
the body of the logs sheet for a dev server found running (opened from development-services and dev-preview): one showKitSheet around a searchable KitLogPanel; no screen of its own.
No surface: what This phone says the app does by itself about a stopped server (the crash recovery owner's state), read by the This phone page.

notes: `termux-setup-installed-reinstall` can chain two sheets (replace-installed at 2511, then unchecked-install at 2525 when `_installation == null`); in practice `installedVersion != null` implies `_installation != null`, so only one appears per tap.

termux_processes_screen.dart:251-259: the details sheet has a protected-process branch, but protected rows call `onProtected` instead of `onOpen` (line 522), so that branch is currently unreachable from the list.
Host-side gates for TermuxAttentionLine (lib/ui/screens/workspace_screen.dart:632) were not read; ServersScreen hosts were read only around lines 97-124 and 677-689.

showConfirmSheet elements carry `file: lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart` with lines 68 (confirm) and 86 (cancel); the default cancel label is the hard-coded English string "Cancel" (confirm_sheet.dart:15), not l10n.

slice P1.3/P1.5 (2026-09-27): the Termux wizard (TermuxSetupScreen, every termux-setup-* step page and its confirm sheets) and the in-app four-step page (BuiltinServerScreen, builtin-server-setup and its remove question) are deleted. termux-setup-installed is This phone (lib/ui/screens/this_phone_screen.dart) for both hosts; the Termux install, update, switch and start run on phone-setup-progress through PhoneSetupTermuxScreen (TermuxHostSetup, lib/state/termux_host_setup.dart). embedded-managed-server-health was already gone from the code and is dropped. Element line numbers of This phone and the Termux host are as of the slice's first draft.
